target.title: fix(gateway): wrap live-probe JSON.parse calls in try/catch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Two `JSON.parse` sites in the gateway CLI live-probe helpers lack error handling:

1. MCP loopback JSON-RPC response parsing (line 237): malformed JSON from a misbehaving local MCP server crashes the probe
2. Cron probe `argsJson` parsing (line 341): operator-configured malformed JSON crashes cron preflight execution

## Why This Change Was Made

Both sites now use try/catch wrappers. The MCP loopback parse uses an inline try/catch. The cron args parse is extracted into a `parseCronProbeArgs` helper with consistent error formatting.

## User Impact

Malformed MCP loopback responses and cron args now produce readable errors instead of crashing the gateway.

## Evidence

**Before**: `JSON.parse(text)` and `JSON.parse(cronProbe.argsJson)` — uncaught SyntaxError → crash

**After**: Both wrapped in try/catch → descriptive errors with `cause` chain

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/gateway-cli-backend.live-probe-helpers.test.ts

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  9 passed (9)
```

**What was not tested**: Live MCP server returning malformed JSON (simulated in unit test would require full mock).

## Risk

Low. Both call sites are diagnostic/probe code, not hot-path execution. Errors are rethrown with clearer messages.
